title: Restocking and Return Label Fees in a Finch Note Reinstatement — Fee Share Note
content:
**Note.** For a Finch Note reinstated on returned merchandise in the Finch Circle Loyalty Program, the reinstatement fee share is the restocking fee deducted from the refund divided by the refunded merchandise before that fee (the refund amount plus the fee, less the sales tax refunded) when a restocking fee was deducted, one half of the prepaid label or carrier pickup fee deducted divided by the refunded merchandise before that fee (the refund amount plus the fee, less the sales tax refunded) when such a fee was deducted, and none (0) otherwise.

The refund amount, the sales tax refunded, the restocking fee and the prepaid label or carrier pickup fee are read from the refund record of the return under Merchandise Purchases. The restocking fee test is read first.

| Refund record shows | Reinstatement fee share |
|---|---|
| a restocking fee deducted | the restocking fee divided by the refund amount plus that fee, less the sales tax refunded |
| no restocking fee; a prepaid label or carrier pickup fee deducted | one half (0.5) of that fee, divided by the refund amount plus that fee, less the sales tax refunded |
| neither | 0 |

## Worked figures (hypothetical)

- Refund amount 270.00 after a restocking fee of 30.00, no sales tax refunded: refunded merchandise before the fee is 300.00, share 30.00 divided by 300.00, that is 0.10.
- Refund amount 100.00 after a prepaid label fee of 8.00, with 8.00 of sales tax refunded: refunded merchandise before the fee is 100.00; one half of the fee is 4.00; share 0.04.
